snippet.title: Once Human: Isles of Abyss — Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Six rules. A strange living ocean. Do you dare set sail?
Once Human — the free-to-play strange worlds survival game — is launching its biggest update ever. Ocean Expansion: Isles of Abyss arrives October 22 on XBOX Series X|S with full cross-play.
A journal washes ashore bearing six rules for survival. And each rule seems to point to a different threat waiting across five ocean regions, and leads to a bigger mystery.
Are you ready? Build your own ship. Survive the living ocean. You can challenge all these strange rules on October 22.
Once Human is already available now with Xbox Game Pass.
